business_summary: ANDRITZ AG is an Austrian industrial plant and equipment supplier organised in four business areas. Group revenue for 2025 was 7,883.1 MEUR: Pulp & Paper 2,956.9 (37.5 percent), Metals 1,694.1 (21.5 percent), Hydropower 1,729.5 (21.9 percent) and Environment & Energy 1,502.6 (19.1 percent). Group EBITA margin 8.2 percent, Hydropower EBITA margin 6.5 percent, net income 457.1 MEUR, cash flow from operating activities 652.7 MEUR, net debt -466.6 MEUR (net liquidity).
